title: Aureline M5 LTS line-creation gate record
description: Canonical per-domain LTS line-creation-gate record minted by the LTS-readiness-decision and line-creation-gate lane over the frozen M5 stable-line-protection matrix. It records the gate scope a candidate line sits in when it asks to create an LTS line or present LTS-style language: LTS committed (a green 91–180 day decision packet exists, so LTS line creation or LTS language is authorized), LTS blocked because its decision packet is missing or its rollback / support evidence is stale (so the line is held at a narrower stable posture), or LTS narrowed to stable (the decision forum declined or deferred, so the line stays plain stable rather than presenting as LTS-grade). Names the gate scope, binds the resolved line identity, the linked LTS-readiness decision-packet reference, the required decision-packet reference the gate checks for, and the active gate reason so release / help, support, shiproom, program-governance, and public-proof surfaces can explain why a line is or is not LTS-ready from packet-backed facts rather than age, enterprise demand, or generic marketing language. LTS remains a checked-in decision packet gate rather than a label a line earns by existing. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's LTS posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
